name: apple-mail
description: Local macOS Apple Mail MCP workflows with 38 tools, IMAP acceleration, account sync, and email management skills.

interface.shortDescription: Manage local Apple Mail through MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: Apple Mail MCP is a local macOS plugin that gives Codex access to Apple Mail workflows through a bundled STDIO MCP server. It supports inbox triage, search, compose, folder management, IMAP-accelerated operations, account sync, analytics, and reusable email management skills. It requires Apple Mail, local Automation permissions, uv, and Python 3.14.
defaultPrompt: Find and organize email by sender.
